shortcuts.desc: Trims elements to meet the edges of other selected elements.
steps: Type 'TR' on your keyboard and hit Enter.
Select cutting edges or press Enter to select all.
Click the parts of the lines you want to remove.
shortcuts.proTip: Hold SHIFT while using Trim to quickly extend lines instead!

shortcuts.desc: Extends lines or objects to meet the boundary edges of another object.
steps: Press 'EX' on your keyboard and press Enter.
Select boundary edges or hit Enter to pick all objects as boundaries.
Click the lines you want to extend toward the boundary.
shortcuts.proTip: Hold SHIFT while using Extend to switch into Trim mode on the fly!

shortcuts.desc: Creates a copy of a sketch line, model line, or wall at a parallel distance.
steps: Press 'OF' on your keyboard to activate the Offset tool.
Hover over the face or edges and click once.
Drag your cursor inside or outside, type the offset dimension, and hit Enter.
shortcuts.proTip: Double-click on any other face to repeat the exact same offset distance instantly!

calendar.title: Top 10 Drawing Shortcuts
calendar.desc: The 10 essential drawing shortcuts every AutoCAD user needs memorized.
calendar.proTip: Type just the alias and press Enter — never touch the ribbon.

calendar.title: Line Command: Ribbon vs Shortcut
calendar.desc: Clicking the ribbon vs typing 'L' and pressing Enter — the difference in speed is massive.
bullets: Never click the ribbon for commands you use daily
calendar.proTip: Time yourself for one week — you'll never go back to ribbon clicking.

calendar.title: Hidden Feature: BOUNDARY
calendar.desc: Need a closed polyline from overlapping lines without redrawing? BOUNDARY auto-traces a clean closed shape.
calendar.proTip: Use BO (short alias) to launch it even faster.

calendar.title: More Drawing Tools
calendar.desc: Beyond Line and Circle — the drawing tools that handle complex geometry.
calendar.proTip: XL is invaluable for setting up reference geometry before you start detailing.

calendar.title: Trim Command Trick Nobody Teaches You
calendar.desc: Press Enter immediately after TR — no cutting edge selection needed. AutoCAD uses ALL visible objects as cutting edges.
bullets: Click anything to trim — it just works
calendar.proTip: Hold Shift while trimming to switch to Extend mode instantly.

calendar.title: Hidden Feature: OVERKILL
calendar.desc: Duplicate overlapping lines causing plot issues? OVERKILL auto-deletes exact duplicates and overlapping geometry in one command.
calendar.proTip: Run OVERKILL before every file submission — keeps your drawings clean.

calendar.title: Polyline Editing
calendar.desc: Everything you can do with polylines that most people don't know about.
bullets: PE – Polyline Edit (join, width, curve fit)
calendar.proTip: Use PE → J to join multiple separate lines into a single clean polyline.

calendar.title: Hidden Feature: MATCHPROP
calendar.desc: Stop manually resetting layer, color, and linetype. MATCHPROP copies all formatting from one object to another in one click.
calendar.proTip: Use the 'Settings' option in MATCHPROP to control which properties get copied.

calendar.title: Essential Editing Shortcuts
calendar.desc: The 10 editing commands you'll use every single day.
calendar.proTip: Learn these 10 before anything else — they cover 90% of your editing workflow.

calendar.title: Layer Walk: The Tool That Finds Hidden Junk
calendar.desc: LAYWALK cycles through every layer interactively — perfect for spotting forgotten or empty layers before a deadline handoff.
bullets: Click each layer in the list
Drawing updates in real time showing only that layer
calendar.proTip: Run LAYWALK before every handoff — you'll catch hidden objects every time.

calendar.title: Hidden Feature: QDIM
calendar.desc: Need to dimension 10 points at once? QDIM auto-generates continuous or baseline dimensions instantly — no clicking one at a time.
calendar.proTip: Select your entire geometry, then run QDIM — works on complex profiles in seconds.

calendar.title: Array & Duplication Commands
calendar.desc: Stop copying objects one at a time — use arrays for any repeating pattern.
calendar.proTip: Associative arrays let you edit the count and spacing live via grip points after creation.

calendar.title: Multileaders vs Old Leaders — Use This Instead
calendar.desc: The old LEADER command is limited. MLEADER gives you styles, multiple leader lines to one note, and auto-formatting.
bullets: MLEADERSTYLE – create your own leader styles
Attach multiple arrowheads to a single note
calendar.proTip: Set up an MLEADERSTYLE matching your project standard once — reuse it across all drawings.

calendar.title: Hidden Feature: DESIGNCENTER
calendar.desc: Stop rebuilding blocks and styles from scratch. ADCENTER lets you drag-and-drop content from any other drawing directly into your current one.
calendar.proTip: Pin your company standards drawing in DesignCenter for instant access to all blocks and layers.

calendar.title: More Editing Tools
calendar.desc: The editing commands that fill the gaps in your workflow.
calendar.proTip: BREAKATPOINT splits a line at an exact point without creating a visible gap — useful for managing overlapping objects.

calendar.title: Dynamic Blocks: One Block, Endless Variations
calendar.desc: A single door block that can stretch width, flip orientation, and change swing angle — all from one block definition.
bullets: Add Visibility states for different types
calendar.proTip: Replace 5 separate door size blocks with 1 dynamic block — cuts your block library significantly.

calendar.title: Hidden Feature: FIELD
calendar.desc: Want your title block to auto-update the date or sheet number? Use FIELD to insert live data instead of static text that goes out of date.
calendar.proTip: Use FIELD for drawing scale, plot date, file path — anything that changes per sheet.

calendar.title: Layer Management Shortcuts
calendar.desc: The layer commands that save hours on complex multi-discipline drawings.
bullets: LAYFRZ – Freeze layer by clicking object
LAYOFF – Turn off layer by clicking
LAYMCUR – Set current layer from object
calendar.proTip: LAYISO is the fastest way to focus on one discipline's content — one click isolates everything.

calendar.title: Link Excel Data Into AutoCAD
calendar.desc: Connect a live Excel schedule to an AutoCAD table — update Excel, and the drawing table refreshes automatically.
bullets: DATALINK – Create a link to an Excel file
TABLE → insert with data link active
Never manually retype a schedule again
calendar.proTip: Link your door/window schedule in Excel so the architect and drafter always have the same numbers.

calendar.title: Hidden Feature: QUICKCALC
calendar.desc: Need a quick calculation without leaving AutoCAD? QUICKCALC (Ctrl+8) opens a built-in calculator that can grab measurements directly from your drawing.
calendar.proTip: Use the GetDist() function in QuickCalc to snap a real distance from the drawing into your formula.

calendar.title: Object Properties Deep Dive
calendar.desc: Controlling object properties the right way — ByLayer discipline and fast property editing.
calendar.proTip: Always keep color, linetype, and lineweight set to ByLayer — this is non-negotiable for professional drawings.

calendar.title: Why Your File Is 200MB (And How to Fix It)
calendar.desc: The cleanup routine that cuts bloated AutoCAD files down to size in under 2 minutes.
bullets: PURGE (PU) – Remove unused blocks, layers, styles
AUDIT – Find and fix drawing errors
Run OVERKILL to eliminate duplicate geometry
calendar.proTip: Do this cleanup routine before every file submission and before archiving projects.

calendar.title: Hidden Feature: Action Recorder
calendar.desc: Repeating the same 10-step process on every drawing? ACTRECORD records a macro once and ACTPLAY replays it — no scripting needed.
calendar.proTip: Record your standard layer setup sequence once — replay it on every new drawing with one command.

calendar.title: More Layer Tools
calendar.desc: Advanced layer management — the tools that handle complex multi-layer drawings.
bullets: LAYMRG – Merge two layers into one
LAYCUR – Move objects to current layer
LAYVPI – Isolate layer per viewport only
calendar.proTip: LAYVPI is critical for paper space workflows — hide a layer in one viewport without affecting others.

calendar.title: QSELECT: Select 500 Objects in One Click
calendar.desc: Demo selecting every instance of a specific block or text style instantly using QSELECT's property filters.
bullets: Filter by a property (e.g., Name = DOOR)
calendar.proTip: Combine QSELECT with CHPROP to change properties of hundreds of objects in seconds.

calendar.title: Hidden Feature: Superhatch (Express Tools)
calendar.desc: Need to hatch with an image, block, or external drawing? Express Tools' Superhatch lets you use anything as a hatch pattern — great for material call-outs.
calendar.proTip: Enable Express Tools via the Add/Remove Programs if you don't see them — they're free with every AutoCAD install.

calendar.title: Dimensioning Shortcuts
calendar.desc: All the dimension commands you need — typed fast, no ribbon required.
calendar.proTip: Use DCO (Continue) immediately after placing one dimension to chain the next — massively faster.

calendar.title: Publishing 50 Sheets in One Click
calendar.desc: The PUBLISH command batch-prints an entire sheet set to PDF automatically — no more plotting sheet by sheet.
bullets: Hit Publish — all sheets export automatically
calendar.proTip: Schedule PUBLISH as a batch job overnight — come in to find 200 sheets already exported.

calendar.title: Hidden Feature: CAD Standards Checker
calendar.desc: STANDARDS checks your drawing against a standards file (.dws) and flags any layer/style naming violations automatically.
calendar.proTip: Share the .dws standards file with your whole team so every drawing passes the same check.

calendar.title: Text & Leader Shortcuts
calendar.desc: The text and annotation commands every drafter needs to know.
calendar.proTip: Use MT for any text that needs formatting — DT is only for single-line labels that never need to wrap.

calendar.title: 3D Editing Commands You're Missing
calendar.desc: The 3D editing commands that most users don't realize exist — powerful once you know them.
calendar.proTip: Use 3DALIGN to precisely position 3D models from point cloud scans against reference geometry.

calendar.title: Hidden Feature: BLOCKREPLACE
calendar.desc: Need to swap every instance of an outdated block with a new one? BLOCKREPLACE does it project-wide in one command — no manual delete and reinsert.
calendar.proTip: Use BLOCKREPLACE when updating a standard symbol across a 50-sheet set — takes seconds instead of hours.

calendar.title: Dimension Style & Management
calendar.desc: Setting up professional dimension styles — the foundation of a clean, consistent drawing set.
bullets: DOV – Override a single dimension's style
calendar.proTip: Always create a project-specific dim style — never use the AutoCAD Standard default for submitted drawings.

calendar.title: 5 Express Tools You're Not Using
calendar.desc: The Express Tools hidden gems that save serious time on repetitive annotation and editing tasks.
bullets: EXTRIM – Trim multiple objects to one boundary
LSPINCLUDE – Load Express Tools automatically at startup
calendar.proTip: TCOUNT is a game-changer for numbering door tags, parking spaces, or room labels.

calendar.title: Hidden Feature: MASSPROP
calendar.desc: Need area, volume, centroid, or moment of inertia? MASSPROP calculates all of it instantly for any solid or region — no manual formulas.
calendar.proTip: Use MASSPROP on closed polyline regions for quick area and centroid checks in 2D too.

calendar.title: Block Basics
calendar.desc: Creating, inserting, and managing blocks — the foundation of reusable CAD content.
bullets: W – Wblock (export block as separate file)
calendar.proTip: Always set the insertion point carefully when creating blocks — it determines where the block snaps on insert.

calendar.title: eTransmit: Sending a Complete Project Package
calendar.desc: ETRANSMIT bundles a drawing with all its xrefs, fonts, and plot styles into a single zip — no more 'missing xref' emails.
bullets: AutoCAD finds and packs all referenced files
Deliver one clean zip to consultants
calendar.proTip: Always use eTransmit instead of just emailing the .dwg — it catches every missing dependency automatically.

calendar.title: Week 1-2 Recap: Top 5 Tips So Far
calendar.desc: The 5 most impactful tips from the first two weeks — save these if you haven't already.
bullets: TR → Enter (trim with all visible edges)
calendar.proTip: Master these 5 before moving on — they'll save you time on every drawing from here.

calendar.title: Block Utilities
calendar.desc: The utilities that keep your block library clean, organized and maintainable.
bullets: RENAME (REN) – Rename a block or named object
MINSERT – Insert a rectangular array of a block in one step
calendar.proTip: Run PURGE with 'Purge nested items' checked to get rid of all orphaned block definitions.

calendar.title: ALIGN: Move + Rotate + Scale in One Command
calendar.desc: Stop doing Move → Rotate → Scale as three separate commands. ALIGN (AL) does all three in one action with reference points.
bullets: Pick 1, 2, or 3 source points on the object
AutoCAD moves, rotates, and scales to fit
calendar.proTip: Use 2-point ALIGN for most tasks — it moves and rotates without affecting scale.

calendar.title: External References (Xrefs)
calendar.desc: Working with external drawings — the foundation of collaborative CAD on any large project.
bullets: XCLIP – Clip an xref to show only part
BIND – Bind an entire xref permanently
calendar.proTip: Use Overlay (not Attach) for xrefs when working in a team — prevents accidental circular references.

calendar.title: REFEDIT: Edit a Block Without Exploding It
calendar.desc: Never explode a block just to fix one line again. REFEDIT lets you edit in place and save back while keeping all instances updated.
bullets: All instances of the block update automatically
calendar.proTip: REFEDIT works on Xrefs too — make changes to a referenced file without opening it separately.

calendar.title: MEASUREGEOM: One Command, All Measurements
calendar.desc: Stop switching between DIST, AREA, and separate radius checks. MEASUREGEOM gives you distance, radius, angle, area, AND volume from one command.
bullets: Choose sub-option: Distance / Radius / Angle / Area / Volume
All in one command — no switching
Replaces DIST, AREA, and separate radius checks
calendar.proTip: Use the Area option with the Object sub-option to measure any closed polyline area instantly.

calendar.title: Tables & Data Links
calendar.desc: AutoCAD tables connected to live Excel data — the right way to manage schedules on engineering drawings.
bullets: DATALINKUPDATE – Refresh linked data from Excel
calendar.proTip: Right-click a linked table and choose 'Update Data Links' after any Excel change — takes 2 seconds.

calendar.title: SCALE & ROTATE: The Reference Option Nobody Uses
calendar.desc: Stop calculating scale ratios and rotation angles manually. Let AutoCAD do the math using the Reference option.
bullets: Pick two reference points — AutoCAD calculates the ratio
calendar.proTip: Same trick works with ROTATE → R (Reference) — pick two points to define the target angle automatically.

calendar.title: Hidden Feature: SECTIONPLANE
calendar.desc: SECTIONPLANE slices through a 3D model and generates a live 2D section view instantly — no manual tracing.
calendar.proTip: Use Live Section mode to drag the plane through the model in real time before generating the output.

calendar.title: Geometric Constraints
calendar.desc: Parametric drawing — define geometric relationships that AutoCAD enforces automatically.
calendar.proTip: Use AUTOCONSTRAIN on existing geometry first — it finds and applies most constraints automatically.

calendar.title: Copy/Paste With Base Point: One Action, Not Three
calendar.desc: Ctrl+Shift+C copies with a base point. Ctrl+Shift+V pastes at exactly the right location — perfectly aligned across drawings.
bullets: Object lands in the exact correct position
calendar.proTip: Use 0,0 as your base point across all project drawings — everything aligns perfectly on paste.

calendar.title: Hidden Feature: BLOCKREPLACE (Revisited)
calendar.desc: BLOCKREPLACE is the most underused productivity command in AutoCAD — swap every instance of a block project-wide in one step.
calendar.proTip: Works across all open drawings when using Sheet Sets — true project-wide replacement.

calendar.title: Dimensional Constraints
calendar.desc: Drive geometry with numbers — parametric dimensions that update the drawing when you change values.
bullets: Changing one value updates all linked geometry
calendar.proTip: Name your parameters clearly (e.g., 'wall_thickness') — you'll thank yourself when editing later.

calendar.title: NCOPY: Copy One Element Straight Out of a Block or Xref
calendar.desc: You don't need to explode a block or xref to steal one piece of it. NCOPY grabs a nested object directly — done in one command.
bullets: Click the nested object inside the block or xref
Place the copy — it lands as an independent object
calendar.proTip: NCOPY is indispensable when you need just one line or symbol from an xref without binding the whole thing.

calendar.title: More Workflow-Compression Commands
calendar.desc: Commands that replace 2-3 steps with one — the hallmark of a fast, efficient drafter.
bullets: PEDIT → Multiple – join + smooth polylines at once
OFFSET → Multiple – offset same object several times
MATCHPROP → Settings – copy only specific properties
STRETCH → Crossing window – move AND resize in one action
calendar.proTip: OFFSET → Multiple is one of the most underused options — keeps the source object active for rapid multi-offset.

calendar.title: Selection & Query Tools
calendar.desc: Select smarter, query faster — the tools that turn 10-minute selection tasks into seconds.
bullets: AREA – Calculate area of a region
ID – Get coordinates of a point
calendar.proTip: FILTER is more powerful than QSELECT for complex multi-criteria selection — worth learning both.

calendar.title: Workflow Compression Bonus List
calendar.desc: A curated list of 'does two things at once' commands that separate fast drafters from slow ones.
bullets: BURST – Explode block, keep attribute values
CHSPACE – Move between model/paper space with auto-scale
SCALETEXT – Resize text height without repositioning
JUSTIFYTEXT – Change alignment without moving text
calendar.proTip: Print this list and stick it next to your monitor — you'll find yourself using these daily within a week.

calendar.title: CHSPACE: Move Objects Between Model & Paper Space
calendar.desc: Stop manually recalculating scale when moving objects between model space and a layout. CHSPACE does it with auto-scale correction.
bullets: Select the object in model space
Object moves to paper space at the correct scale
Works in reverse too — paper to model
calendar.proTip: CHSPACE is essential for moving annotation notes between layouts and model space correctly.

calendar.title: Plotting Essentials
calendar.desc: Everything you need to know to plot correctly — page setups, plot styles, and PDF export.
calendar.proTip: Save a named Page Setup for each common output (A1 PDF, A3 PDF) — reuse in seconds.

calendar.title: DATAEXTRACTION: Auto-Pull Block Data Into a Table
calendar.desc: Stop manually counting block instances for schedules. DATAEXTRACTION builds a complete schedule table — or exports to Excel — automatically.
bullets: Choose which attribute properties to extract
Output as an AutoCAD table or export to Excel
calendar.proTip: Link the extracted table back as a DATALINK so the schedule auto-updates when blocks change.

calendar.title: BURST: Explode a Block Without Losing Attribute Values
calendar.desc: Never use EXPLODE on an attributed block again. BURST keeps the actual filled-in values intact as real text.
bullets: EXPLODE on attributed block → values disappear
BURST on same block → values convert to text
The block explodes to geometry + real text
calendar.proTip: BURST is an Express Tool — make sure Express Tools are enabled in your installation.

calendar.title: Layouts & Viewports
calendar.desc: Paper space, layouts, and viewports — the setup that every professional drawing uses.
bullets: MVIEW (MV) – Create a viewport in a layout
VPLAYER – Control layer visibility per viewport
calendar.proTip: Lock viewport scale (double-click the viewport border → Properties → Lock Display) to prevent accidental zooming.

calendar.title: SCALETEXT & JUSTIFYTEXT: Fix Text Without Moving It
calendar.desc: Two commands that solve text formatting problems in one step — no repositioning afterward.
bullets: SCALETEXT – Resize multiple text objects to a new height in place
JUSTIFYTEXT – Change text justification without the text jumping
Select all affected text at once
Works on MText, DText, and Attribute text
calendar.proTip: SCALETEXT is perfect when a client asks you to change all annotation from 2.5mm to 3mm height project-wide.

calendar.title: DATAEXTRACTION: Build Your Door Schedule in 2 Minutes
calendar.desc: A practical walkthrough of using DATAEXTRACTION to auto-generate a door schedule from block attributes.
bullets: Tag all door blocks with number attributes
AutoCAD builds the complete schedule table
calendar.proTip: Run the extraction again after any door additions — the schedule updates in under 30 seconds.

calendar.title: Layouts & Viewports (Deep Dive)
calendar.desc: Advanced viewport control — the techniques that make your sheet layouts professional.
bullets: VPLAYER – Hide layers in specific viewports only
MS / PS – Toggle in/out of viewport quickly
Set viewport scale via Properties palette
CHSPACE – Move objects between spaces with scale correction
calendar.proTip: Never set viewport scale by zooming manually — always use the Properties palette for exact 1:100, 1:200 scale.

calendar.title: SOLPROF & FLATSHOT: Auto-Generate 2D Lines From a 3D Model
calendar.desc: Stop manually tracing 3D views to create 2D drawings. SOLPROF and FLATSHOT do it automatically.
bullets: SOLPROF – 2D profile of a 3D solid for current view
FLATSHOT – Flatten entire 3D model to 2D lines
Both generate clean linework from viewpoint
Export to paper space layouts for elevation drawings
calendar.proTip: Use FLATSHOT for quick elevation extractions from 3D models — delivers clean 2D geometry in seconds.

calendar.title: OOPS, SETBYLAYER & FIND: Quiet Time-Savers
calendar.desc: Three commands that fix common headaches in one step each — most people don't know they exist.
bullets: OOPS – Restores last erased object, even after other commands (unlike UNDO)
SETBYLAYER – Forces all object properties to ByLayer in one step
FIND – Find and replace text across entire drawing including inside blocks
calendar.proTip: FIND works inside blocks — the only way to bulk-update block text without exploding everything.

calendar.title: Sheet Sets for Multi-Drawing Projects
calendar.desc: The professional workflow for managing large drawing sets — Sheet Set Manager explained.
bullets: NEWSHEETSET – Create a new sheet set
Publish entire sheet sets to PDF in one click
Auto-updating title block fields across all sheets
calendar.proTip: Sheet Sets are essential for any project over 10 drawings — the time investment pays back immediately.

calendar.title: Basic 3D Solid Primitives
calendar.desc: The building blocks of 3D modeling in AutoCAD — every primitive command you need.
calendar.proTip: Switch to '3D Modeling' workspace before starting 3D — gives you all the right tools upfront.

calendar.title: SELECTSIMILAR & ISOLATEOBJECTS: Smarter Selection
calendar.desc: Two commands that replace manual multi-object selection — instant isolation and bulk selection by property.
bullets: SELECTSIMILAR – Right-click → select all matching objects instantly
ISOLATEOBJECTS – Isolate selected objects regardless of layer
calendar.proTip: ISOLATEOBJECTS is perfect for focusing on one detail area without touching layer visibility at all.

calendar.title: Complex 3D Shapes
calendar.desc: Beyond primitives — the commands that create any complex 3D form from 2D geometry.
bullets: REVOLVE (REV) – Spin a profile around an axis
calendar.proTip: PRESSPULL on a closed region is the fastest way to create a simple solid — just drag and type a height.

calendar.title: Boolean Operations
calendar.desc: Combine, subtract, and intersect 3D solids — the core logic of solid modeling.
bullets: UNION (UNI) – Combine two solids into one
SUBTRACT (SU) – Cut one solid with another
INTERSECT (IN) – Keep only the overlapping volume
SLICE (SL) – Cut a solid with a plane
calendar.proTip: SUBTRACT is how you create holes, notches, and cut-outs in 3D — model the cutter separately then subtract it.

calendar.title: THICKEN & CONVTOSOLID: Instant Solid Conversion
calendar.desc: Stop rebuilding 3D geometry from scratch — convert existing surfaces directly into solids.
bullets: THICKEN – Turn a flat surface into a solid with set thickness
CONVTOSOLID – Convert meshes/surfaces to solids directly
THICKEN works on any AutoCAD surface
calendar.proTip: Use THICKEN on surfaces imported from Rhino or SketchUp to make them solid for Boolean operations.

calendar.title: Custom Keyboard Shortcuts & Aliases
calendar.desc: Build your own shortcuts — stop using defaults that don't match your workflow.
bullets: Edit acad.pgp file to add/change aliases
REINIT – Reload aliases after editing the PGP file
calendar.proTip: Remap the 5 commands you use most to single-letter aliases — you'll feel the speed difference within an hour.

calendar.title: Tool Palettes & Workspaces
calendar.desc: A workspace that fits how you actually work — custom palettes and saved ribbon layouts.
bullets: TOOLPALETTES (Ctrl+3) – Custom palettes with your blocks/hatches
CUIEXPORT – Export your setup for use on another PC
calendar.proTip: Build one Tool Palette per project discipline (Structural, Civil, MEP) — one click to switch contexts.

calendar.title: Intro to AutoLISP (No Coding Experience Required)
calendar.desc: You don't need to write code to use AutoLISP routines — just load and run them.
bullets: APPLOAD – Load a .lsp routine into AutoCAD
Free community LISP routines exist for auto-numbering, batch attribute editing, area labeling
VLIDE – Visual LISP Editor for viewing/editing routines
calendar.proTip: Search 'AutoCAD LISP routines free download' — thousands exist for common civil/architectural tasks.

calendar.title: Advanced Object Snap & Tracking
calendar.desc: Precision drafting depends on these — beyond basic endpoint/midpoint snaps.
bullets: Polar Tracking (F10) – Snap to precise angles
Object Snap Tracking (F11) – Track from multiple reference points
calendar.proTip: Enable only the snaps you actively use — too many running snaps causes snap conflicts on complex drawings.

calendar.title: Groups & Advanced Selection
calendar.desc: Group related objects so you never lose track of them — and selection cycling for overlapping geometry.
calendar.proTip: Named groups are searchable — GROUP → Name gives you click-to-select across complex drawings.

calendar.title: Advanced Array Techniques
calendar.desc: Beyond basic arrays — the array features that handle real civil and structural patterns.
bullets: Associative Arrays – edit one item, whole array updates
Array along a 3D path (for structural/civil layouts)
Edit count/spacing live via grip points
Convert array to independent objects: ARRAYEDIT → Explode
calendar.proTip: Associative arrays are the key feature — always leave them associative until you're 100% done editing.

calendar.title: Advanced Xref & Collaboration Workflow
calendar.desc: Working across a full engineering team — the xref discipline that prevents file corruption and circular references.
bullets: Overlay vs Attach – know the difference before nesting drawings
XREF notification/reload workflow for team file updates
LAYERSTATE – Save and restore layer configs per discipline
XCLIP for showing only the relevant project area
calendar.proTip: Overlay xrefs are always safer in team environments — they don't nest and can't cause circular references.

calendar.title: Sheet Set Advanced Techniques
calendar.desc: Taking Sheet Sets beyond the basics — professional multi-project workflows.
bullets: Custom sheet set templates with pre-filled title block fields
Sheet set Fields linked to project data (name, number, client)
Batch-renumber sheets across an entire set
eTransmit to package a full project for consultants
calendar.proTip: Sheet set Field values update on all sheets simultaneously — change the project number once, updates everywhere.

calendar.title: AutoCAD 2D Complete Cheat Sheet (Full Recap)
calendar.desc: Every 2D command from Day 1 — compiled in one master reference. Screenshot and save this.
bullets: Drawing: L, PL, C, REC, ARC, POL, EL, XL, DIV, MEA

calendar.title: AutoCAD Advanced Cheat Sheet (Full Recap)
calendar.desc: Every advanced tip from the series — power-user commands compiled in one graphic.
bullets: Customization: CUI, PGP aliases, REINIT, TOOLPALETTES, WORKSPACE
Collaboration: XREF, XCLIP, ETRANSMIT, LAYERSTATE, STANDARDS
Express Tools: TCOUNT, TXTEXP, EXTRIM, MPEDIT, SUPERHATCH
calendar.proTip: Share both cheat sheets with your team — a shared vocabulary makes collaboration significantly faster.

calendar.title: Workflow Compression Recap #1
calendar.desc: The first half of the 'One Command Instead of Three' series — every time-saving shortcut compiled.
bullets: ALIGN – Move + Rotate + Scale in one
REFEDIT – Edit a block in place
MEASUREGEOM – All measurements in one command
calendar.proTip: These commands don't just save time — they reduce errors by eliminating manual intermediate steps.

calendar.title: Workflow Compression Recap #2
calendar.desc: The second half of the compression series — more commands that eliminate unnecessary steps.
bullets: NCOPY – Extract from block/xref without exploding
CHSPACE – Move between spaces with auto-scale
BURST – Explode block keeping attribute values
SCALETEXT / JUSTIFYTEXT – format text without moving it
calendar.proTip: Combine NCOPY with CHSPACE for a powerful pattern: extract content from xrefs and position in layouts.

Revit 3D: Families, modeling, levels and grids
